battle.name: 越南戰爭
battle.theater: 越南中部平原與北部戰線
battle.brief: 1959年11月起，北越支持的越共在南方全面升級游擊，南越軍與美軍顧問捲入其中，至1975年4月30日西貢陷落，戰事延續十五年有餘。卡面1840年法國雷管步槍並未參戰，其雷管擊發與膛線技術經M1加蘭特、M14、AK-47傳入叢林，決定了雙方步槍射程與散兵線的展開。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰由兩個國家政權、三支武裝與一支國際部隊構成。北越方面是1945年9月2日胡志明在河內宣布成立的越南民主共和國，主席胡志明、總理范文同，軍隊為越南人民軍，總司令武元甲自1946年起主持軍務至1980年，參謀總長先後由文進勇與李文成擔任，黨與軍的樞紐在黨中央軍委書記阮志清（Nguyễn Chí Thanh）手中，他以「陳春華」的化名在南方指揮政治與游擊作戰；南方游擊隊另以越南南方民族解放陣線的名義活動，與人民軍配合作戰。南越方面是1955年成立、由吳廷琰出任總統的越南共和國，軍隊為越南共和國陸軍，參謀總長阮文願等分掌軍令，第三軍區長期駐防中部平原。第一線是美國：駐越美軍司令部設於西貢，司令由韋斯特摩蘭（Westmoreland）更替到艾布拉姆斯（Abrams），兵力在1968至1969年達到頂峰；同時有南韓藍龍部隊、澳洲與紐西蘭營級分遣隊、菲律賓特遣隊，以及寮國與柬埔寨境內的割據軍。背後是一張援助網：蘇聯自1965年起提供地空導彈、MiG-21與顧問團，中國自1965年至1970年先後輪換派出約32萬名解放軍指戰人員與工程兵進入北越，承擔築路、築橋與維持小道運輸，古巴與蒙古亦派員參與。
countriesEn: The war was fought between two state regimes, three armed organizations and one international force. On the northern side there was the Democratic Republic of Vietnam, proclaimed by Ho Chi Minh in Hanoi on 2 September 1945, with Ho Chi Minh as president and Pham Van Dong as prime minister; its armed forces were the People's Army of Vietnam, whose commander in chief General Vo Nguyen Giap ran the military from 1946 until 1980, while the post of chief of the general staff passed from Van Tien Dung to Le Trong Tan, and the real hub of party and army lay with Nguyễn Chí Thanh, secretary of the party central military commission, who directed politics and guerrilla operations in the south under the alias Tran Cong Ai; the southern guerrillas operated in the open under the name of the National Liberation Front of South Vietnam and fought in concert with the regular army. On the southern side there was the Republic of Vietnam, founded in 1955 with Ngo Dinh Diem as president; its army was the Army of the Republic of Vietnam, with chief of staff Nguyen Van Ngo and others issuing the orders, and III Corps stationed for long periods in the central plains. The first line was American: the Military Assistance Command, Vietnam, was based at Saigon, its commander passing from Westmoreland to Abrams, and the troop level reached its peak in 1968 and 1969; alongside it served ROK Blue Dragon units, battalion-sized Australian and New Zealand detachments, a Philippine task force, and the fragmented armed groups operating inside Laos and Cambodia. Behind these lay a web of assistance: from 1965 the Soviet Union supplied surface-to-air missiles, MiG-21 fighters and an advisory group; between 1965 and 1970 China rotated some 320,000 People's Liberation Army personnel and engineers into North Vietnam, where they built roads and bridges and kept the trail open; Cuba and Mongolia also sent contingents.
people: 關鍵人物分屬交戰兩端與幕後。北越與越共方面：胡志明自1945年起主持國策，1960年與中國簽訂中越協議，北越在整場戰爭中把中國視為主要後盾；武元甲以人民軍總司令身份統兵，既是1968年1月春節攻勢的主要策劃者之一，也長期推動人民戰爭的三階段方針；黎德壽自1967年起在北越黨中央政治局任職，並在1973年的巴黎談判中代表北越一方；文進勇以參謀總長身份統籌軍隊建設與後勤；阮志清以「陳春華」化名主持南方游擊戰，是1960年12月主力南進的推動者之一。南越方面：吳廷琰自1955年起以總統兼國防部長身份推行集權與反共特別法，1963年11月2日在宮中遇刺；阮文琦以軍人背景掌兵，1964年1月出任總統，推行越戰化並在1972年的防衛反攻中主持全局，1975年4月23日離境；阮文願出任陸軍參謀總長，第三軍區與第一軍區的司令官輪替頻繁。美國方面：總統約翰遜在1964年8月東京灣事件之後取得國會授權，1965年3月派遣海軍陸戰隊在峴港登陸；國防部長麥克納馬拉以戰爭成本理論主導對北越的空襲與兵力投入；韋斯特摩蘭任駐越美軍司令部司令，推行搜索與殲滅作戰與特種部隊建設；尼克松政府自1969年起推行越戰化與撤軍，艾布拉姆斯接任指揮；國務卿基辛格與布unker（Bunker）在巴黎談判中斡旋停火。戰場上雙方都沒有全戰役的單一指揮官：北方以軍、師為作戰單位，南方游擊隊以連、排為基本單位，指揮權下放到營級；美軍則以駐越美軍司令部與野戰部隊司令部兩層運作，特種部隊顧問團自1965年起在南部各省協助組織游擊隊。被擊落後遭拘押的美軍飛行員如麥克恩（John McCain）構成另一條無形的戰線，數千名俘虜的命運直接左右了談判。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities fall into the two belligerents and the backstage. On the northern and southern guerrilla side: Ho Chi Minh directed national policy from 1945, and the 1960 agreement with China made the People's Republic the main external guarantee of North Vietnam for the whole war; Vo Nguyen Giap, as commander in chief of the People's Army, was both one of the principal planners of the January 1968 Tet offensive and the long-time advocate of the three-stage strategy of people's war; Le Duc Tho sat on the politburo of the North Vietnamese party from 1967 and represented North Vietnam at the Paris talks of 1973; Van Tien Dung, as chief of the general staff, organized the building of the army and its logistics; and Nguyễn Chí Thanh, working under the alias Tran Cong Ai, ran the guerrilla war in the south and was one of the men who pushed the main body of the army south in December 1960. On the southern side: Ngo Dinh Diem, president from 1955 and concurrently defence minister, built a centralised regime around special anti-communist legislation and was assassinated in his palace on 2 November 1963; Nguyen Van Thieu, an army man who took over the presidency in January 1964, pursued Vietnamization and directed the defensive counter-offensive of 1972, and left the country on 23 April 1975; Nguyen Van Ngo served as chief of staff of the army, while the corps commanders in I and III Corps turned over frequently. On the American side: President Johnson obtained congressional authorisation after the Gulf of Tonkin incident of August 1964 and landed marine expeditionary troops at Da Nang in March 1965; Secretary of Defense McNamara drove the bombing of North Vietnam and the commitment of troops through his cost-exchange theory of war; Westmoreland commanded MACV, pressing search-and-destroy operations and the building of the special forces; the Nixon administration turned to Vietnamization and withdrawal from 1969, with Abrams taking over command; and Secretary of State Kissinger, with Bunker, worked the Paris talks for a ceasefire. On the battlefield neither side had a single commander for the whole war: the north fought with corps and divisions as operational units, the southern guerrillas worked in companies and platoons with command pushed down to battalion level, and the American forces ran on two levels, MACV above and field headquarters below, with the special forces advisory group helping to organise guerrillas in the southern provinces from 1965. Captured American aircrew such as John McCain formed another invisible front, since the fate of several thousand prisoners of war weighed directly on the negotiations.
kits: 卡面那支1840年法國雷管步槍並未出現在本役戰場，它是這場戰爭裡幾乎所有步槍的技術祖型。1840年法國軍用雷管步槍把底火引入槍械，射手不必再靠火石應付潮濕天候，膛線配合圓錐形彈也讓精度趨於穩定。它的直系後裔是1874年Gras步槍、1886年Lebel步槍、1907年Berthier步槍與1936年MAS-36；二戰之後法國把大批Gras、Lebel與MAS-36連同7.62毫米口徑改裝件供應南越，1960至1970年代南越軍與民兵手上同時出現這些老式栓動步槍與美援的M1加蘭特、M14。北越與越共方面，蘇制AK-47（1947年）、AKM（1959年定型）、SKS、PKM通用機槍、DP-28手提機槍、蘇制RPK以及中國56式與63式步槍構成主力，RPG-2（1959年定型）與RPG-7火箭筒在1965年後大量用於伏擊美軍車隊，另有B-40火箭筒與82毫米、120毫米迫擊炮。美軍方面，M1加蘭特是1965年前後南越美軍的標準步槍，M14在1959年制式化，M16於1964年制式、1965年配發到前線，M60A1通用機槍、M2重機槍與M1919A4輕機槍構成火力骨幹，M79與M203榴彈槍提供班排直射支援，反裝甲武器有AT4、TOW與BGM-71龍式導彈。砲兵與航空方面有105毫米與155毫米榴彈炮、203毫米核裝載火炮、B-52同溫層堡壘、F-4幽靈、F-105與A-4天鷹；直升機UH-1休伊、CH-47支奴干、CH-54與AH-1眼鏡蛇把地面部隊快速送入林區。裝甲與運輸有M113裝甲車、PT-76坦克、法國AMX-13、中國59式與63式坦克，以及M35與M54卡車和穿插在叢林小道上的三輪車運輸隊。
kitsEn: The 1840 French percussion rifle on the card never appeared on this battlefield; it is the technical ancestor of almost every rifle fought in this war. The French service percussion rifle of 1840 introduced the primer into the weapon, so that the shooter no longer had to depend on a flint in wet weather, and the rifled barrel combined with the conical bullet made accuracy far steadier. Its direct descendants were the 1874 Gras rifle, the 1886 Lebel, the 1907 Berthier and the 1936 MAS-36; after the Second World War France supplied South Vietnam with large quantities of Gras, Lebel and MAS-36 rifles together with 7.62mm conversion parts, so that in the 1960s and 1970s South Vietnamese regulars and militia carried those old bolt-action rifles side by side with American M1 Garands and M14s. On the northern and southern guerrilla side the main body was Soviet: AK-47 of 1947, AKM standardised in 1959, SKS, PKM general purpose machine gun, DP-28 light machine gun, Soviet RPK, together with Chinese Type 56 and Type 63 rifles; RPG-2, standardised in 1959, and RPG-7 rocket launchers were used in quantity against American vehicle columns after 1965, backed by B-40 rocket launchers and 82mm and 120mm mortars. On the American side the M1 Garand was the standard service rifle of South Vietnamese and American troops around 1965, the M14 was standardised in 1959, the M16 was standardised in 1964 and issued to the front line in 1965, and the M60A1 general purpose machine gun, the M2 heavy machine gun and the M1919A4 light machine gun formed the backbone of firepower; the M79 and M203 grenade launchers gave direct support at platoon and squad level, and anti-tank weapons included the AT4, TOW and BGM-71 Dragon. In artillery and aviation there were 105mm and 155mm howitzers, 203mm guns capable of firing nuclear rounds, B-52 Stratemakers, F-4 Phantoms, F-105s and A-4 Skyhawks, while the helicopters UH-1 Huey, CH-47 Chinook, CH-54 and AH-1 Cobra carried ground troops rapidly into the forest. In armour and transport there were M113 armoured carriers, PT-76 tanks, French AMX-13s, Chinese Type 59 and Type 63 tanks, and M35 and M54 trucks together with the three-wheeled convoys that worked the forest tracks.
tactics: 雙方戰術體系完全不同。北方推行人民戰爭的三階段方針：先在鄉村建立游擊隊與地方基層，再以游擊隊消耗與包圍城市，最後由正規軍接管。南方游擊隊以排、連為基本單位，三五成群在叢林與村落之間轉移，靠徒步與自行車輸送彈藥、白米與情報；白天在村落或林間休息，夜間行軍，襲擊哨所、伏擊巡邏隊、破壞公路與橋樑，或以B-40火箭與迫擊炮攻擊目標。北方主力自1960年12月起大舉南進，1968年1月30日發動春節攻勢，以師、團為單位在數百公里戰線上同時打擊城市、機場與交通線，一度攻入西貢與中部各大城；中部山區的坑道與地下工事讓攻守形勢幾度逆轉。1969年後北方轉入持久戰與消耗模式，胡志明小道上的火箭與迫擊炮襲擊幾乎每日進行。美軍方面，1965年3月2日發動「滾動雷霆」對北越的空襲並持續三年，1967年推出「冰屋」行動，以傳感器與特種部隊封鎖胡志明小道，1967至1972年更執行「播種」行動，試圖以人工降雨改變季風、削弱北越的農業與後勤；地面採搜索與殲滅作戰，以M113與步兵營沿公路搜索，UH-1與CH-47實施垂直包抄，炮兵與空軍對地面部隊提供近距火力支援。北越以地空導彈S-75與MiG-21對抗F-4，並用ZSU-23與ZSU-57高射炮組成低空防線。1972年北方發動復活節攻勢，以數十個師進入南越，安祿之戰守方堅守逾二百五十天；1975年春季，第二、第四、第五軍等部隊同時進攻，最後以坦克部隊直取西貢。
tacticsEn: The two sides ran entirely different tactical systems. The north pursued the three-stage strategy of people's war: first build guerrillas and a local base in the villages, then use them to exhaust and encircle the towns, and finally hand the country over to the regular army. Southern guerrilla units worked in platoons and companies, groups of three or five shifting between jungle and hamlet, carrying ammunition, white rice and intelligence on foot and by bicycle; by day they rested in villages or forest shelters, at night they marched, raided outposts, ambushed patrols, cut roads and bridges, or struck targets with B-40 rockets and mortars. From December 1960 the main body of the northern army moved south in force, and on 30 January 1968 the Tet offensive was launched, with divisions and regiments striking towns, airfields and lines of communication simultaneously along a front of several hundred kilometres, entering Saigon and the great cities of the centre; the tunnel and underground positions in the central highlands reversed the course of the fighting several times. After 1969 the north turned to protracted war and attrition, with rocket and mortar attacks on the Ho Chi Minh trail taking place almost daily. On the American side Operation Rolling Thunder opened the bombing of North Vietnam on 2 March 1965 and ran for three years; in 1967 Operation Igloo White was launched to seal the trail with sensors and special forces patrols, and between 1967 and 1972 Operation Popeye sought to alter the monsoons by artificial rain in order to undermine agriculture and logistics in the north. On the ground the Americans fought search-and-destroy missions, sweeping the highways with M113s and infantry battalions, using UH-1 and CH-47 for vertical envelopment, with artillery and air support close behind the infantry. The north answered with S-75 surface-to-air missiles and MiG-21s against the F-4, and built a low-altitude shield of ZSU-23 and ZSU-57 anti-aircraft guns. In 1972 the north launched the Easter Offensive, pushing several dozen divisions into South Vietnam, where the defence at An Loc held out for more than two hundred and fifty days; in the spring of 1975 the 2nd, 4th and 5th Corps attacked on several axes at once and the tank columns went straight for Saigon.
data: 可核的數字集中在兵員與損失。時間上，通行寫法是1955年11月1日開戰、1975年4月30日西貢陷落，1973年1月27日《巴黎和平協議》簽訂，1973年3月29日美軍最後一批部隊離境。兵員方面，1968至1969年駐越美軍峰值約543,400人，先後有約259萬人被派往越南；1973年撤軍之後僅餘約3,500人。南越方面，越南共和國陸軍與民兵在高峰期約有85萬至90萬人；北越人民軍在越南境內的兵力峰值約30萬至35萬人，外加南方游擊隊。損失方面，美軍作戰死亡58,220人，受傷逾15萬人，被俘約7,600人，其中約1,564人死於拘押期間；南越軍作戰死亡約25萬人；北越與越共軍隊的死亡與失蹤，各方統計從約125萬到160萬不等，美方估計多取140萬上下。戰役層面，1968年春節攻勢中美軍陣亡1,589人，南越軍死亡約5,000至6,000人，1968年全年美軍死亡16,592人，是整場戰爭最慘烈的一年。航空方面，美軍在越南損失各型飛機逾8,000架、直升機約4,900架，南越損失飛機約1,700架、直升機逾2,500架。開支方面，以1975年幣值計，美國直接花費約1,200億美元，外援另計。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around personnel and losses. On duration, the usual reckoning is that the war opened on 1 November 1955 and ended with the fall of Saigon on 30 April 1975; the Paris Peace Accords were signed on 27 January 1973, and the last American troops left on 29 March 1973. On strength, American troops in Vietnam peaked at about 543,400 in 1968 and 1969, and some 2.59 million Americans were sent to Vietnam over the course of the war; after the withdrawal in 1973 only about 3,500 remained. On the southern side, the Army of the Republic of Vietnam and the paramilitary together numbered roughly 850,000 to 900,000 at their peak; in the north, the People's Army of Vietnam had a strength of some 300,000 to 350,000 inside Vietnam, in addition to the southern guerrillas. On losses, the United States recorded 58,220 men killed in action, more than 150,000 wounded and about 7,600 taken prisoner, of whom some 1,564 died in captivity; South Vietnamese forces lost about 250,000 men killed in action; for northern and southern communist forces the estimates of dead and missing range from about 1.25 million to 1.6 million, with American assessments usually around 1.4 million. At the level of engagements, the United States lost 1,589 men during the Tet offensive of 1968 and South Vietnam lost about 5,000 to 6,000, while American deaths in the whole of 1968 reached 16,592, making that the deadliest year of the war. In aviation, American losses in Vietnam ran to more than 8,000 aircraft and about 4,900 helicopters, and South Vietnam lost roughly 1,700 aircraft and more than 2,500 helicopters. On cost, the direct American expenditure was about 120 billion dollars at 1975 prices, with foreign aid counted separately.
cause: 戰爭的起因是一連串被強行焊接的決定。1954年7月《日內瓦協議》以北緯17度把越南劃為南北兩半，暫時終止法國在印度支那的戰爭；1955年10月吳廷琰在南越就任總統後拒絕履行協議中1956年全國統一的選舉安排，越共隨即在南方以游擊隊形式重建地方武裝，衝突從村級事件升級為連續的營級作戰。美國的介入有其冷戰邏輯：艾森豪威爾的骨牌理論把越南視為阻止共產主義擴張的關鍵，肯尼迪政府於1961年重整特種部隊與反叛亂援助，1964年8月2日至4日的東京灣事件中兩艘美軍驅逐艦遭魚雷快艇襲擊，8月7日國會通過東京灣決議，1965年3月海軍陸戰隊在峴港登陸，3月2日起對北越實施持續空襲。北越與越共在中國與蘇聯的支援下把游擊戰推向1960年之後的鼎盛期，1965年後正規主力部隊大舉南進，戰爭由一場內戰變成有美軍直接介入的國際戰爭。寮國與柬埔寨境內的戰役、美國對全面轟炸與地面進攻的顧慮、以及北越在談判中提出的美軍撤出與俘虜交換要求，共同把停火談判拉成四年拉鋸，最終導致1975年北方的總攻。
causeEn: The causes of the war were a chain of decisions welded together under force. The Geneva Accords of July 1954 divided Vietnam along the seventeenth parallel and temporarily ended the French war in Indochina; when Ngo Dinh Diem took office as president in the south in October 1955 he refused to carry out the provision for nationwide unification elections in 1956, and the communists rebuilt their local armed forces in the south as guerrilla units, so that the conflict rose from village incidents to continuous battalion action. American involvement followed its own cold-war logic: Eisenhower's domino theory made Vietnam the key to stopping communist expansion, the Kennedy administration reorganised the special forces and the counter-insurgency aid in 1961, and in the Gulf of Tonkin incident of 2 to 4 August 1964 two American destroyers were hit by torpedo boats; Congress passed the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution on 7 August, marine expeditionary troops landed at Da Nang in March 1965, and sustained bombing of North Vietnam began on 2 March. With Chinese and Soviet support, North Vietnam and the southern guerrillas drove guerrilla warfare to its height after 1960; once regular main bodies moved south in force after 1965, what had been a civil war became an international war with American troops on the line. Fighting inside Laos and Cambodia, American fears of an unrestricted ground offensive, and the northern demands for American withdrawal and for exchange of prisoners stretched the ceasefire talks into a four-year tug of war that ended with the general offensive of 1975.
impact: 影響分國內與國際兩層。對越南本身，戰爭把國家分成南北兩個政權並持續近二十年，1968年之後雙方都把大量資源耗在軍備上，經濟結構傾斜，農業與交通遭到反覆破壞，1973年的協議未能阻止戰爭再起，1975年4月30日西貢陷落後南北統一，1976年改名越南社會主義共和國，隨後又因柬埔寨問題與中國邊境衝突而再陷戰事。對美國，58,220人的作戰死亡與約1,200億美元的開支帶來政治代價，反戰運動擴大，1973年國會通過限制行政權對外用兵的韋伯-格里芬修正案，軍隊改行全志願兵役制；越戰的經驗也重塑了美國的戰爭學說：直升機垂直包抄的價值被確立，UH-1的廣泛使用成為空中機動戰的樣板，M16的可靠性問題與後勤物資的混亂則成為教材。對亞洲，冷戰前沿從朝鮮半島延伸到印度支那，寮國與柬埔寨的政權更替、中越關係與中蘇分歧的變化、中美在1972年之後的接近，都以這場戰爭為前提，越南問題也成為中美關係正常化談判中的核心籌碼之一。
impactEn: The effects work on two levels, at home and abroad. For Vietnam itself, the war split the country into two regimes for nearly twenty years; after 1968 both sides poured resources into armament, the economic structure tilted toward the military, and agriculture and transport were repeatedly destroyed. The 1973 agreements did not stop the war from resuming, and after the fall of Saigon on 30 April 1975 the country was reunified and renamed the Socialist Republic of Vietnam in 1976, only to go back to war over Cambodia and the border with China. For the United States, 58,220 men dead in action and roughly 120 billion dollars of expenditure carried a political price: the anti-war movement grew, Congress passed the War Powers Resolution in 1973 to limit the executive's freedom to wage war abroad, and the armed forces moved to an all-volunteer force. The experience of Vietnam also reshaped American doctrine: the value of vertical envelopment by helicopter was established, the wide use of the UH-1 became the model for airmobile operations, and the reliability problems of the M16 and the confusion of logistics supplies became textbook warnings. For Asia, the cold-war front was extended from the Korean peninsula into Indochina; the changes of regime in Laos and Cambodia, the shifting relations between China and Vietnam and between Moscow and Beijing, and the Sino-American rapprochement after 1972 all presupposed this war, and the Vietnamese question became one of the central counters in the normalisation talks between Washington and Beijing.
result: 結果是北方全面勝利。1968年之後西貢當局節節退守，1973年1月27日《巴黎和平協議》簽訂，規定美軍在1973年3月前撤出，交換條件是美軍釋放所俘北越與越共人員；協議生效之後南越軍與北方游擊隊的衝突並未停止，1975年1月北方發動春季攻勢，人民軍以第二、第四、第五軍等部隊攻破外圍，4月21日總統阮文琦赴北京與中國領導人會談，4月23日以辭職名義離境；4月29日美軍執行鷹爪與常風系列撤離行動，海軍艦載直升機把美軍與南越政府人員一批批撤走，最後一架自藍嶺號航母起飛；4月30日上午10時21分，北方坦克駛入西貢市區，獨立宮宣讀無條件投降書，越南共和國政府終結，南方游擊隊與北方正規軍在分別作戰數十年之後第一次同時出現在同一面旗幟下。戰後，越南以河內為首都合併南北，1976年成立統一政府；1978年越南出兵柬埔寨，1979年中越在邊境爆發戰事，越南在美蘇之間重新定位，這一格局一直延續到冷戰結束之後。
resultEn: The result was a complete northern victory. After 1968 the Saigon government was driven back step by step, and on 27 January 1973 the Paris Peace Accords were signed, requiring the American withdrawal by March 1973 in exchange for the release of captured northern and southern communist personnel. Once the agreement took effect the clashes between South Vietnamese troops and northern guerrillas did not stop, and in January 1975 the north launched its spring offensive, the People's Army breaking the perimeter with units of the 2nd, 4th and 5th Corps among others; on 21 April President Nguyen Van Thieu travelled to Peking to meet the Chinese leadership, and on 23 April he left the country under the fiction of a resignation. On 29 April the Americans ran the Eagle Pull and Frequent Wind evacuation operations, shipborne helicopters ferrying American and South Vietnamese government personnel out in successive waves, the last aircraft lifting off from the carrier Blue Ridge. At 10:21 on the morning of 30 April northern tanks drove into the centre of Saigon, the unconditional surrender was read at the Independence Palace, and the government of the Republic of Vietnam came to an end; for the first time in decades the southern guerrillas and the northern regular army appeared under the same flag. After the war, north and south were merged under a capital at Hanoi and a unified government was established in 1976; in 1978 Vietnamese forces entered Cambodia, in 1979 fighting broke out on the border with China, and Vietnam took up a new position between the United States and the Soviet Union, a pattern that lasted well beyond the end of the cold war.
